name: stata-research-guard
description: Provides Stata main rules, a compact command index, Stata 18 help-first evidence with live exact-help fallback, and command-selective expanded documentation plus selected paper context.

interface.shortDescription: Stata 18 help-first command and research context.
interface.longDescription: Lets the model inspect a compact 115-command Stata index, choose exact commands, and retrieve bundled Stata 18 official or maintainer help for registered commands. Exact commands outside the index are resolved on demand from the active Stata installation inside this Guard MCP, without restoring an mcpStata help tool. When bundled help is insufficient, Phase 3 supplies registered commands' whole Stata 18 PDF entries or a limited author supplement plus optional exact paper code and directly linked raw log or artifact excerpts. The model decides commands and context. The plugin does not scan projects, score or rank candidates, promote templates, grade generated code, or certify a research design.
defaultPrompt: Use the skill and get_stata_command_evidence to read the main rules and compact command index, choose exact commands, then read bundled or live installed help first.
When more context is needed, request expanded documentation only for the exact selected-command subset that needs it, and request exact paper blocks independently.
Treat paper examples and optional raw logs as nonbinding source context; preserve the current project and selected research specification.
Proceed from help when it fully explains the requested action and the code follows directly; report material help gaps and do not treat paper examples as grammar authority.
